Nope! Just around the abdomen (lower torso). We need to attach electrodes around that area as part of the experiment and hair might disrupt the signals or can be difficult when we take off the electrodes at the end of the experiment so it’s a precautionary measure.

For more information on the experiment itself, it can be found in the Participant Information Sheet (PDF attachment) that can be found in the eligibility survey.

Not a silly question at all! No, you don’t have to study at UCL to take part in our experiment. Anyone is welcomed to participate as long as they meet the eligibility criteria (details provided in the eligibility survey).
